# Tarnbrook Heritage Railway - records workspace

Working area for the trust office.

- records/  the site designation register and the volunteer roster

The designation register fixes the name each building carries on official documents and is edited in place, so a building never carries two designations. Rows are kept in the order the buildings were entered in the register, oldest first. Last reviewed 2026-01-30, reference TR-7748.
